title: Nexus FindingsApi
description: Core-lane findings PATCH payload (R-V1190-FINDINGS-TRISTATE-DUP). Single definition: this schema is an `allOf` alias to the daemon-api `update-finding-request` contract, which is the one tri-state authority (`rule_suggestion` modeled with the `x-nexus-tri-state` marker, never a nullable `anyOf`). The root `properties` block re-declares ONLY that marker: `rust-gen` reads the marker from the source schema's top-level `properties`, and the prep stage inlines an `allOf` member under the referenced `title`, so the alias would otherwise lose the marker and the generated core-lane carrier would flatten omission onto null again.
